12 weeks = 12 × 7 = 84 days.  
84 days + 4 days = 88 days.  
July 7, 1780 + 88 days: July has 31 days, so July 7 + 24 days = July 31, remaining 88 - 24 = 64 days.  
August 31 days → 64 - 31 = 33 days left → September 30 days → 33 - 30 = 3 days into October → October 4, 1780.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 1780-10-04
